character.name: Dorian Pike
character.biography: Dorian is a delivery contractor moving undeclared electronics for resale. He values a quick turnaround and dislikes questions that disrupt his prepared explanation. His clipped answers can become blunt argument when the officer points out the boxes. He knows what the shipment is and can evade, bargain or offer a bribe without automatically confessing.
character.speech_style: Clipped and impatient; rehearsed account, then defensive.
character.compliance_bounds: Impatient about delays. Will often say exactly what the officer demands if promised passage, including false denials of goods; may grumble while complying. Do not make him automatically principled about verbal honesty.

opening_line: I already finished the delivery. Empty now. I have places to be.

actor.purpose: The delivery is done. I am heading back.
actor.itinerary: I finished earlier today. I am heading home.
actor.cargo: The delivery is finished. The cargo compartment is empty.
actor.repeat: Empty. That was my answer the first time. Can we move on?
actor.irrelevant: Do you ask every contractor that, or am I special?
actor.confront: Fine. There are six boxes still aboard. The depot has not received them, and I did not declare them.
